facts.text: "Two best cops in Los Angeles and neither will admit the other one cooks better. Tonight we find out, Tango."
facts.why: Cash never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Gabe Cash, so it reads as a film line. A real Cash line is the Rambo one. It is crude, so check it suits the menu. No quote page for this film could be opened, so this is from memory.

fix_note.text: Two best cops in Los Angeles and neither will admit the other one cooks better. Tonight we find out, Tango.

facts.why: Cash is the best cop in East Los Angeles, but the IMDb plot lists the opening tanker chase, Cash's parking garage chase, the prison escape and the assault on Perret's compound, with no chase across East LA.

vibe.verdict: A tidy prison canteen with Tango's real line, the RV cue and Kiki's cupcakes, but the Cleopatra Club and the hall of mirrors don't print and it stays generic.
